calculation.formula: IF ([Parameters].[param_region] = "Global" OR [country (rpt_marketing_mofu_leads)] = [Parameters].[param_region]) AND ([Parameters].[param_segment] = "All" OR [employee_segment (rpt_marketing_mofu_leads)] = [Parameters].[param_segment]) AND ([Parameters].[param_channel] = "All" OR [channel_group] = [Parameters].[param_channel]) AND ([Parameters].[param_direction] = "All" or [direction] = [Parameters].[param_direction]) AND ([Parameters].[param_mqltsubype] = "All" or [requested_demo] = [Parameters].[param_mqltsubype]) AND ([report_date] >= [cf_comparison_startdate] AND [report_date] <= [cf_comparison_enddate]) THEN IF [Parameters].[param_mqltype] = "All" THEN [mql_count] + [recycled_mql_count] ELSEIF [Parameters].[param_mqltype] = "New" THEN [mql_count] ELSEIF [Parameters].[param_mqltype] = "Recycled" THEN [recycled_mql_count] END END
